candidates.place_reason: 306e audit 2026-10-13: similarity (4 pts, resid 0.0 m, 1.00 m/px, -0.0 deg). The 4 anchors are a perfect 100-px diagonal ladder (300,300)-(600,600), so the fit carries no placement information; the site point (Corn Market) inverse-maps to the centre of the drawn bailey. The drawn keep (the dark square '1') is ~170 m south of the real moated keep island at the site point, over a built-up block just north of the Thames; the drawn bailey (~450 x 380 m) and the plate's big hill outline (~665 x 540 m) render over the flat built-up city with no corresponding earthworks or hill (1842 and LiDAR are flat); only the drawn river (185-230 m south) lands on the real Thames. Wrong place, right kind (the bury-castle class). Document deleted.
candidates.why: line check: fabricated anchor pattern: 2D lattice (regular ladders on both page axes); grid-round page coordinates (8 of 8 distinct values on a 10-px grid); the gate's 0.0 m measures internal consistency of the anchors, not their truth
